About — gathernomoss 0 Skip to Content ABOUT COLLECTION WOMENS MENS KIDS GIFT SWIM GIRLS BOYS SERVICES CONTACT LOGIN Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT COLLECTION WOMENS MENS KIDS GIFT SWIM GIRLS BOYS SERVICES CONTACT LOGIN Open Menu Close Menu ABOUT Folder: COLLECTION Back WOMENS MENS KIDS GIFT SWIM GIRLS BOYS SERVICES CONTACT LOGIN About Us Gather no moss is a multidisciplinary Print Design Studio with over 35 years of experience in the textiles and fashion industry. We have a dedicated team of designers who create original designs inspired by the latest trends, and a dynamic sales team to bring those concepts directly to you. Our Story Gather No Moss Textile Design Studio was founded in London, England by Tom Bambridge-Sutton and James Hartley. Since our inception in 1987 we have grown into one of the world's leading textile design studios, with a team of highly skilled designers, International agents and an innovative and diverse print collection powered by thepatterncloud. At our core we prioritise quality design and the highest level of service for our clients, implementing the latest techniques with a customer focused approach. We have a longstanding and passionate team and we believe that good trend-driven design should be accessible regardless of our clients location. With these principles at heart we have striven to create the world’s best online collection of exclusive printed textile designs. Our collection is available for our clients to browse and buy 24/7. Our Design Team Our highly skilled team of global print designers is led by Art Director Fiona White, whose experience and expertise spans over 24 years. Our designers produce contemporary and original prints, rooted in hand rendered illustration. The diversity of our team guarantees a broad perspective on trends from around the world, and a wide range of handwriting styles to fit your needs. All artwork is supplied as high quality digital files. Our seasonal collections cater to a variety of products and markets, from womenswear & menswear to kids, swim, and gifting. Additionally our designers can work to tailored briefs to cater to clients needs. For more information on creating custom artworks, or service work, please see our design services page. Our Sales Team Our Sales team is managed by Charlotte Baxter who has over 14 years experience covering all categories of print design. Charlotte has an eye for detail and, with her vast knowledge of our collection, is an expert in helping customers find the print they want at the time they need. She collaborates closely with Fiona and the design team in order to bring the highest level of personal service to our clients. Just contact her below with any query and she will guide you to the right area of our website, or meet with you virtually to walk you through the latest trends, and our collection online. CONTACT CHARLOTTE Design Services Our team provide a personalized experience working to your print needs and specifications. We have extensive experience and pride ourselves on our creative and technical expertise to bring you the highest quality service. For more information about how we can assist you, please head to our design services page. DESIGN SERVICES Get the latest trend news! Subscribe to our newsletter to hear about our seasonal collection releases from our world beating print design studio. Email Address SUBSCRIBE Thank you! © 2026 gather no moss, all rights reserved. Website design by Jenny Bowskill
